advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Encode `test_inbound_delete_link_round_trips` as `@pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason=...)` naming [rebar:2b16-9be0-a8f5-41d9] as the removal condition, so the known gap does not permanently red the gating suite and the marker breaks (flagging the stale expectation) the moment the inbound differ gains a link-removal path.
evidence: Docstring: `EXPECTED RED — AND THE PRODUCT, NOT THIS CELL, IS WHY. \`inbound_differ._diff_links_inbound\` is ADD-ONLY by construction` (test_dc_mutations.py:679-681)

Final assertion pins the unimplemented desired behavior: `assert other_local not in after, (... The inbound link differ is ADD-only (\`inbound_differ.py:380,396\`) — see [rebar:2b16-9be0-a8f5-41d9].` (test_dc_mutations.py:741-746)
Only decorators are `@_skip` / `@_skip_no_extra` (environment gates); no `pytest.mark.xfail` anywhere in the module — `search_files('xfail', tests/external/live_jira_dc)` returned no matches

Source confirms the gap is real and not test-side: `"""Reflect Jira issuelinks into rebar relations. ADD-only.` and `ADD-only (no REMOVE mutations).` (src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/inbound_differ.py:380,396)
Ticket [rebar:2b16-9be0-a8f5-41d9] is status=open and its description says the cell 'should go RED on the harness until this is addressed'

Contrast with the module's correct pattern for a known non-round-trip: `with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError) as caught: dc_transport.set_parent(key, key)` asserts CURRENT behavior (test_dc_mutations.py:893)
advisory.finding: `test_inbound_delete_link_round_trips` is a known-permanently-failing test — it asserts the local dep is removed after a Jira link delete, but the inbound link differ is ADD-only by construction (inbound_differ.py:380,396) and the gap is filed as the OPEN bug [rebar:2b16-9be0-a8f5-41d9]. The cell is added as a plain assertion with only environment-gating skips and NO `xfail(strict=True)`, so it reds the live harness on every run and cannot be distinguished from a genuine regression in the inbound-link path, nor will it flag when the product is fixed.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add `@pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason="inbound differ is ADD-only; inbound link removal not yet mirrored — see rebar:2b16-9be0-a8f5-41d9")` above the existing skip decorators, keeping the ABSENCE oracle unchanged. strict=True makes the build break when the bug is fixed, so the marker cannot go stale.
